scope: Offline diagnostic; no engine/card changes. Finish and stop. Four seen seasons, not blind. Second-half observed lineups are explicit oracle conditions, never called preseason forecasts.

acquisition.integrity: Audit echoed dates, player GP <= corresponding official box appearances, nonempty table, no duplicate IDs; first+second OREB and chances reconcile to cached full-season within1% summed absolute difference. If a season fails, no fitting/evaluation for it; missing older training seasons stops fit rather than substituting latest seasons.

cutoff: One league calendar date, the date of median regular-season game; every game on cutoff belongs to first half. Cup final excluded by official002 regular-season games. No per-team K.

context.role: First-half individual AST/36 determines order among five. Proxy leader share is stint-time fraction with focal highest AST/36; exact ties split1/n. Do not call it observed ballhandling or starting PG.
context.competition: Stint-time weighted sum of OTHER FOUR players first-half tracking OREB_CHANCES/36. Same first-half profiles used for both halves; focal omitted. Missing/new players use prefix league median, never second-half rates.
context.lineups: Use existing strict-game lineups. Exclude missingPbp, lineupFailed, uncertainPossessionGames, counterMismatchGames. Strict game counts must match prior audit. No coordinates manufactured.
context.features: Own first-half chance36, log1p(first-half box MIN), first-half AST36; independent additions deltaRole (second-first), deltaCompetition (second-first). These deltas use known later membership/time but only prefix individual traits. No post abilities, team efficiency, on-off or outcomes as features.
context.confounding: Within-person changes remove fixed person differences, not time-varying scheme, shot mix, misses, injury or teammate selection. Opportunity is period aggregate, not per-lineup chance labels.

cohort.rule: Both halves meet box and tracking MIN; first tracking chances>=10; valid raw conversion[0,1]; valid second chance/36. Existing strict stints cover>=70% box MIN in each half. Tracking-missing rows not silently counted as zeros; all exclusions listed.

estimator.type: Ridge predicts second-minus-first chance36; intercept unpenalized; train-only imputation/scaling; grouped five-fold player SHA256 modulo5 CV; larger lambda on tie.
estimator.weight: min(second-half box MIN,1000) normalized; test MIN used for evaluation only.
estimator.clip: Predicted chance36>=0. Derived OREB36=predicted chance36*first-half raw conversion; no second conversion, clipping multipliers or result calibration.

models.boxPersistence: First-half box OREB36, OREB outcome only.
models.chancePersistence: First-half chance36; derived rate is first-half tracking OREB36.
models.history: Chance delta predicted from own first chance36, logMIN, AST36.

metrics: Second-half chance36 and box OREB36 MAE/RMSE weighted by second box MIN; tests pooled equal season weights, Pearson descriptive. No team net/wins metric or engine adoption.
descriptive: Each season weighted correlation and slope of within-player chance change vs role/competition changes; roleUp>=.15, roleDown<=-.15; competitionUp>=1 and down<=-1 chance36. Descriptive only. List known trade/mover groups via half maximum-minute teams, not causal trade estimate.

uncertainty.scheme: Paired franchise resampling crossed Poisson1 individual weights, common franchise and player weights across seasons/models; no simulation seed or training-refit uncertainty.
uncertainty.primary: Six pooled TEST OREB36 MAE comparisons: role/competition/both vs boxPersistence and history;95% plus Bonferroni99.1667%. All other comparisons exploratory.

decision: A context candidate supported only if pooled held-out OREB36 MAE Bonferroni intervals wholly negative vs BOTH references, chanceMAE95 not significantly worse vs history, and each test-season/mover OREB36 MAE95 not significantly worse vs boxPersistence. Even success is oracle-context evidence, not a causal participation coefficient or engine adoption.
geometryInventory: Inspect first3 sorted PBP file names per season for coordinate fields; count per-action x/y and whether ten-player position trajectories exist. Sampling only, no claim of full-data spatial completeness.
